description:
Facts about one top-level domain from local datasets: whether it is delegated in the root zone, its type (country-code or infrastructure when derivable), the registry's RDAP server, root-zone name servers, whether the root zone publishes a DS record (DNSSEC) and which DS algorithms, and any Web3 namespace that claims the same label (for example .eth, .crypto, .bnb, or a collision such as .xyz).

Use it to answer where to send an RDAP query for a TLD, whether a TLD is signed, or whether a name under it could mean something else on a blockchain. For one domain use lookup_target instead.

Behavior: offline and instant, answered from synced IANA and root-zone data; makes no network call. A field without data is omitted, never guessed. Registry operator and delegation date are not included.

tld.description: one top-level domain with or without the leading dot, e.g. com, .de, xn--p1ai or рф. A full domain name is not accepted

name: get_tld_info

collision.description: delegated in the root zone and also a Web3 namespace

dnssec.description: the root zone publishes a DS record for the TLD

summary.description: the human-readable fact sheet, the same text as the text content

web3_namespaces.description: Web3 namespaces that claim this label

title: Top-level domain facts
